headlines.title: UnitedHealth Group (UNH) Draws Breakup Pressure As AI Threat Enters The Story
headlines.summary: UnitedHealth Group (NYSE:UNH) is facing renewed breakup calls from Senator Elizabeth Warren after its Amedisys acquisition settlement. Warren has urged federal regulators to revisit antitrust concerns around UnitedHealth's growing role across insurance, care delivery, and home health. Mark Cuban has warned that artificial intelligence could disrupt or "collapse" large healthcare players, explicitly citing UnitedHealth as vulnerable.

headlines.title: UnitedHealth Group Board Authorizes Payment of Quarterly Dividend
headlines.summary: November 04, 2026--The UnitedHealth Group (NYSE: UNH) board of directors has authorized payment of a cash dividend of $2.32 per share, to be paid on December 15, 2026, to all shareholders of record of UNH common stock as of the close of business December 7, 2026.

headlines.title: UnitedHealth Group Incorporated (UNH) Rebounded After Better-Than-Expected Results: Mott Capital’s Take
headlines.summary: Mott Capital Management, an investment research and management firm, released its “Thematic Growth Strategy” Q3 2026 investor letter. A copy of the letter can be downloaded here. headlines.title: UnitedHealth Just Gained 11% in a Month: Take Profits, or Buy More?
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysUnitedHealth Group (UNH) stock gained approximately 11% in the month through October 30, supported by stronger third-quarter earnings and another increase to its 2026 profit outlook. Operating earnings climbed to $6.

headlines.title: ‘We Need to Break Up Big Medicine’: Elizabeth Warren Says Trump DOJ Gave UnitedHealth ‘More Power’ in $3.3 Billion Amedisys Deal
headlines.summary: Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) blamed President Donald Trump‘s administration for letting UnitedHealth Group Inc. buy Amedisys Inc. for $3.3 billion, arguing it gives the insurer more power to raise costs and deny care.

description: UnitedHealth Group Incorporated operates as a health care company in the United States and internationally. It operates through four segments: Optum Health, Optum Insight, Optum Rx; and UnitedHealthcare. The Optum Health segment provides care delivery, care management, wellness and consumer engagement, and health financial services with patients, consumers, care delivery systems, providers, employers, payers, and public-sector entities. The Optum Insight segment offers software and information products, advisory consulting arrangements, and managed services outsourcing contracts to hospital systems, physicians, health plans, public entities, life sciences companies and other organizations. The Optum Rx segment provides pharmacy care services and programs, including retail network contracting, home delivery, specialty and community health pharmacy services, infusion, and purchasing and clinical capabilities, as well as develops programs in the areas of step therapy, formulary management, drug adherence, and disease and drug therapy management. The UnitedHealthcare segment offers consumer-oriented health benefit plans and services for national employers, public sector employers, mid-sized employers, small businesses, and individuals; Medicaid plans, including Temporary Assistance to Needy Families; Children's Health Insurance Programs; Dual SNPs; Long-Term Services and Supports; Aged, Blind and Disabled; and other federal, state, and community health care programs. and health care benefits products and services to state programs caring for the economically disadvantaged, medically underserved, and those without the benefit of employer-funded health care coverage. UnitedHealth Group Incorporated was founded in 1974 and is based in Eden Prairie, Minnesota.
